text: Medros was an obscure Continental Celtic god. He held a connection to cattle. Medros may be a Celtic version of the Persian hero-god Mithras. The Persian god was popular among Roman legionnaires. The soldiers brought his cult to the Celtic lands.
objective: Document Medros, the obscure Continental Celtic god connected with cattle.
key_results: Record Medros as an obscure Continental Celtic god.
Record his possible identity as a version of Mithras.
Record the Roman channel of the Mithras cult.
